[Foreign language] Also, please be reminded that unless otherwise stated, all figures mentioned during the conference call are in Chinese RMB. [Foreign language] With that, let me now turn the call over to our Co-CEO and CFO, Ms.
Lisa Tang [Foreign language] Lisa, Over to you, Lisa。
Lisa Tang
Co-CEO and CFO, Boqii
Thank you Elle, and many thanks to everyone for joining the call today.
At the beginning of FY 2024, despite the challenges of market uncertainty, we made great strides in revenue mix enhancement and cost control, with high margin private labels showcasing its resilience and indirect costs also seeing a notable drop in amount and percentage to revenue, laying the foundation for a solid H1. [Foreign language] As part of the management team, we totally believe that we are moving in the right direction, and we maintain confidence in the development of China's pet industry.
We will continue to work diligently and passionately, and we will keep a keen eye on market dynamics and opportunities so that we can generate sustainable returns to our shareholders.
Let's pass the time to Elle to further update you on the operational and business developments in H 2024. [Foreign language]。
Elle Lai
Head of Investor Relations, Boqii
Thank you, Lisa. In fact, despite the uncertainties in the macroeconomy, China's pet economy continued to demonstrate its potentials. According to the latest report, the penetration rate of households owning pets in China is expected to continue its rising trend, reaching 22% in 2023. That number is still way behind that in the United States and Europe, suggesting substantial room for expansion.
By 2025, it is predicted that China's pet market will hit RMB 811.4 billion, representing a CAGR of 19.8% from 2021 to 2025. [Foreign language] All these reassure us that China's pet market is going to eventually rebound.
Hence, during H1, Boqii focuses on strengthening its market position, enhancing its brand profile, improving its user stickiness, refining its product offerings, and streamlining its business operation in preparation for the better wave in the future. [Foreign language] particular, customer loyalty will be the major growth driver for the group as the listed pet company.

Leveraging our extensive user data and excellent big data capability, we were able to optimize our private labels product offerings to better cater to pet parents' needs while reducing our carrying costs for non-performing SKUs. Although the group suffered a drop in overall GMV of private labels actually enjoyed an increase of 2.1% to RMB 212.9 million.
Its revenue contribution to overall revenue also rose from 17.8% to 26.4%, leading to a stable performance in gross margins and post-fulfillment margins, with gross margins standing firm at 20% and post-fulfillment margins enjoying an uptake of 170 basis points to 11.2%. As we grow as a brand along with the comprehensive content and customized product selection on offer, there was also rising user stickiness, which was reflected in the historic low CAC, down by 46% year over year to merely RMB 2.8.
Customer purchase frequency also increased from 1.32 last year to 1.34 this year, with growth seen across both new and existing customers. [Foreign language] Overall, we remain confident in our unique positioning in China's expanding pet market.
We have observed encouraging trends, including a significant rise in the number of pets and the increasing popularity of pet e-commerce, which bodes well for the future of us as the pet industry aggregator. We will continue our journey to establish a well-rounded ecosystem that delivers values to both pet parents and brand partners.
We are enthusiastic about building upon our leading position, hopefully creating a more resilient and impactful industry presence in the future. [Foreign language]
Lloyd Dai
Financial VP, Boqii
Thank you, Elle. In the following I'd like to share more on our financial performance for H1 FY 2024. We continue to execute our strategic adjustment and business optimization. [Foreign language] Our revenue for H1 FY 2024 was RMB 389.4 million, down by 34% year on year.
As a result of the worsening consumer sentiment and consumption downgrade in China, overall gross profit margin only decreased by 100 basis points to 20%, with gross profit reaching RMB 77.9 million. [Foreign language] We also made notable efforts on cost control as we improved the operational efficiency of our logistics services.
Fulfillment expenses as a percentage of revenue for the H1 decreased to 8.9% compared to 11.6% over last year. Fulfillment expenses decreased 49.4% to RMB 34.5 million.
That lays the foundation of an improving fulfillment margin, increasing from 9.5% last year to 11.2%. [Foreign language] S&M expenses decreased 28.6% to RMB 45.4 million, mainly due to the growing efficiency of customer acquisition from more cost-efficient channels. [Foreign language] G&A expenses were RMB 32.2 million compared to RMB 22.1 million for the H1 year of fiscal 2023.
The increase was mainly due to the increase in share-based compensation expenses. [Foreign language] came to a net loss of RMB 37.7 million in H1 FY 2024, and then non-GAAP net loss is RMB 34.2 million. We did FD Line and PIPE transaction in H1 2024, and the related expenses of RMB 7 million is recorded in net loss.
Also in H1, for the first time, we applied rule of ASC 326 of expected credit loss model to assess credibility of accounts receivable and other receivables. The expected credit loss of RMB 3 million is recorded in net loss. If excluding above two one-off effect, our net loss is RMB 27.7 million, representing an improvement of 6% compared to the same period of last year.
Non-GAAP net loss is RMB 24.2 million, representing an improvement of 15%, which show our capacity of breakeven in the short-term future. [Foreign language] On our financial position as of 30 September 2023, our effective debt to asset ratio stood at 39.5%.
Our total cash and cash equivalents were RMB 86.8 million, a drop of RMB 72.8 million, mainly due to a decrease of RMB 71 million in short-term borrowings compared to 31 March 2023. With no major CapEx foreseen and a strong credit line backup, we believe we are cash sufficient to support our operation and pursue new initiatives.
Besides, in September 2023, we entered into certain financing agreements with third-party investors, which will also provide us additional capital to explore our new business opportunities. [Foreign language] Moving forward, we will continue to strengthen our reach and control throughout the value chain.
This includes investments, collaborations, and strategic initiatives that would reinforce our closed-loop community.
We believe this approach would allow us to become not only the go-to place for pet parents, but also the go-to partner for brands, manufacturers, distributors and developers in China or soon to be in China. [Foreign language] Here wraps up my summary.
